task.ques: Browse Booking's homepage to find out which company it belongs to.

claude.final_answer: FINAL: Booking.com belongs to Booking Holdings Inc. The Booking.com homepage footer states: “Booking.com is part of Booking Holdings Inc.” Source: https://www.booking.com/ (viewed October 27, 2026). Evidence: final.png.
